\begin{example} \end{example}[Rescaled nested-cylinder iteration] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0335 ↗ lem:chow-iii-moser-cylinder-iteration 1. ch25:25.7\group Moser Iteration

For the radii $r_i=r(1+(\gamma -1)2^{1-i})$. \end{example}
Proof

\sketch For these radii, $r_i-r_{i+1}=r(\gamma -1)2^{-i}$. Spatial and temporal cutoffs therefore have squared-gradient and time-derivative bounds $C4^i((\gamma -1)r)^{-2}$. Substitution in the one-step Sobolev estimate and multiplication over $i$ gives powers $\sum \beta ^{-i}=n/2$ and $\sum i\beta ^{-i}<\infty $. The radius gap contributes exactly $(\gamma -1)^{-n/4}$, proving the lemma.
